d:
The International Villager magic, back with a brand-new video Ashke is Money Aujla’s song from Yo Yo Honey Singh’s legendary album International Villager, with music by Honey Singh himself and lyrics by Money Aujla.
The album that changed Punjabi music forever still hits just as hard, and Ashke is one of its gems. Turn it up!
• Album: International Villager
• Song: Ashke
• Singer: Money Aujla
• Featuring: Yo Yo Honey Singh
• Music: Yo Yo Honey Singh
• Lyricist: Money Aujla
